subject: Re: Risk-explanation status: reproduction done, explanation stability is the real question
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of the Jun 19 pilot-readiness gate:

1. Ensemble attribution is the only mode we ship. The clinical review on May 22 was unambiguous - the advisor said single-seed explanations would erode trust within a week, and the 91% top-3 overlap number was the difference between a polite meeting and an engaged one. Single-seed stays as an internal debug mode.
2. Pilot scope: one partner, retrospective data only, no live clinical use. That matches Kofi's April sign-off conditions exactly (thanks for the tight turnaround, Kofi - cleared Apr 14, inside the SLA).
3. Scope cut: multi-label support (beyond in_hospital_death) moves to the next phase. Bilal's ingestion generalizes already, but validating explanations per label is real work we shouldn't rush.

Vera, Gustavo - the review packet was the best clinical-facing doc this portfolio has produced. Reuse it as the template.

Dmitri
